name: Channel Spirit (Mythic)
body:
Though you may not be a medium, you have a strict relationship with your spirit guide.

Prerequisite(s): Channel Spirit

Benefit(s): The spirit bonus you gain from one spirit selected with the Channel Spirit feat is equal to the spirit bonus you would gain from a medium level equal to your character level. You also can select a taboo, and let your spirit gain influence over you as if you were a medium.

Special: You may select this feat once for every spirit selected with the non-mythic version of Channel Spirit. This feat counts as having the spirit ability for all prerequisites.
